reasoning: On the season so far the Bulls are the stronger team; with home court the Bulls start about 7 points better, in a game of about 244 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing barely change it.
The mental side leans about 1 point towards the Bulls (confidence, revenge).
Bottom line: the Bulls win 71 times in 100, by about 7; most games like this end between 218 and 266 total points.

analyst.text: Washington snapped an eight-game losing streak in Toronto behind Anthony Davis and a career night from AJ Dybantsa, which eases some pressure on Brian Keefe, whose job The Athletic says could be in danger; Trae Young has publicly backed him. Chicago have won three of four, Josh Giddey says 'I like where the team's going', and they lost the October meeting. The angle leans towards Chicago.
